name: How do I choose the right crown molding size and style for my kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right crown molding size and style for my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose crown molding profiles by matching the architectural style, ceiling height, and scale of your kitchen. Standard eight-foot ceilings generally look best with modest crown profiles between two and four inches high so cabinets do not appear top-heavy. Taller nine- or ten-foot ceilings can handle substantial four- to six-inch stacked profiles with risers. Style-wise, contemporary and shaker kitchens call for clean, flat-stock, or stepped profiles, whereas traditional kitchens benefit from ogee, cove, or dentil detail work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Match the molding profile to your cabinet door style and scale the height to your ceiling—smaller two-to-four-inch profiles for eight-foot ceilings and larger profiles for taller rooms.
